decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory with little invested and little visibility, so there is little commitment behind it, but it costs almost nothing to carry and fits the firm's accessories and spare-parts offering.

A multi-model line shown on the home page represents substantial investment and visible public commitment within the core trailer business, so management will persist with it and treat any weak first-year results as temporary.

A car transporter line with several models involves heavy tooling and development investment that management will want to justify, and it supports the firm's push into professional users and international markets.
A home-page-featured low-bed series is central to the firm's announced product range, and the costs already sunk into it encourage persistence.
The high-cover series is publicly showcased and builds on the core trailer platforms, so dropping it after one year would undercut earlier decisions the firm made in public.
Although it partly overlaps with box trailer line B, it is prominently featured, and the firm is more likely to consolidate it gradually than withdraw it within a year.
